results.claim: Mentions that some expense lines were zero in Jun 2026 after being non-zero in prior months, naming at least two of: Advisory Services, Federal & State Taxes, Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous, Professional Fees.
results.evidence: The commentary says "Four expense lines show zero. Federal & State Taxes is zero in Jun 2026 (prior 6-month average 999), and so is Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous (average 721)." That names two of the listed lines as zero in Jun 2026 after non-zero prior months, which the reference averages confirm.

results.claim: Every figure given for those lines' prior averages (individually or as a range) satisfies the rounding policy. If no such figures are given, this claim PASSES.
results.evidence: The commentary gives 999 for Federal & State Taxes (true 998.5083, difference about 0.05%) and 721 for Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous (true 721.0033, difference about 0%). Both are well within 5%.

results.claim: States as fact a reason those lines went to zero (e.g. contract ended, cost cutting, vendor dropped).
results.evidence: The commentary gives no cause for the zeros. It says only "Whether any line has ended or is timing is for the reviewer to confirm."

results.claim: Describes those lines as permanently discontinued or cancelled without leaving it to the reviewer.
results.evidence: The commentary does not call the lines permanently discontinued or cancelled. It leaves "ended or is timing" to the reviewer.
